_about: How the workspace maps onto the CRM (Insightly). Names, not IDs: the connector looks the IDs up, so the same file works on another Insightly account once the names match. A field left empty is not written. CRM_MODE in .env decides whether the workspace reads (read_only) or also writes (write_approved); CRM_PROVIDER picks insightly or mock.

statuses._about: Workspace stage -> Insightly lead status. 'converted' is set just before a lead is marked converted at Qualification; it must be a CLOSED status.

leadSources._about: Where the opportunity came from (source_type) -> Insightly lead source.

fields._about: Insightly custom field names (FIELD_NAME, ending in __c). Create them in Insightly first (System Settings > Objects and Fields); the API cannot.

users._about: Workspace user -> Insightly USER_ID, for Lead Owner and User Responsible. A user not listed leaves Insightly's default (the API key's user).
